title: VIXEN configure should honor an explicit Undertow CMake root
body: The configured build could not find the paired catalogue when UNDERTOW_ROOT was supplied only as a CMake definition; configure succeeded only after exporting UNDERTOW_ROOT in the environment. Make one documented root input drive both configure and codegen discovery.

title: VIXEN local kernel override should derive its selected SHA
body: Pointing YEROKET_ROOT at the lane kernel still rejected the source until the same full commit was duplicated in VIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE. Derive the effective pin from the selected local root or expose one canonical override.

title: VIXEN codegen checks should invalidate outputs when the local kernel changes
body: A fresh gpu_systems_check used stale generated output after the kernel emitter changed; a manual gpu_systems_regen was required before the check became meaningful. Include the selected kernel source/tool fingerprint in generated-output invalidation.

title: Publish the configured merged-SDI drift target name
body: The intuitive sdi_merged_check target failed as unknown; the configured target is libraries/ShaderManagement/tools/sdi_merged_drift_gate and had to be recovered from build.ninja. Provide a stable top-level alias and document it.

title: Publish RenderGraph test executable paths after configure
body: The built test_rendergraph_core executable was not under the source-prefixed build path and the first queued run exited 127; locating build/wsl/libraries/RenderGraph/tests/test_rendergraph_core manually fixed it. Emit or expose a stable runner target/path.
